wish: someone should make a tool that runs SQL on CSV files
spec:
Loads CSV files (open, drop or paste) as tables named after the file and runs SQL SELECT queries on them in the browser.
Supports WHERE, JOIN / LEFT JOIN, GROUP BY with COUNT/SUM/AVG/MIN/MAX, HAVING, ORDER BY, LIMIT, DISTINCT, UNION, subqueries, CASE and common string/number functions; results can be downloaded as CSV.
Does not modify the files: no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE, no RIGHT/FULL JOIN, no window functions; nothing leaves the device.

type.text:
name,city,age
Ada,London,36
Alan,London,41
Grace,New York,85
Linus,Helsinki,22
SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n, MAX(age) AS oldest FROM people WHERE age > 30 GROUP BY city ORDER BY n DESC

notes: Small SQL engine written for this tool; CSV columns are typed as numbers when every value is numeric (leading-zero codes stay text). Tables and the last query are kept in localStorage when they fit.
